description: This file declares the StateHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which manages lifecycle state transitions, creation, validation, and state transition tracking for a plugin component. It includes method declarations for initializing, changing states, creating states, validating transitions, and updating states, along with static member variables for tracking state changes and possible transitions.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing lifecycle state transitions, creation, validation, and tracking within the plugin.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateHandler, setting up necessary state or resources.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Attempts to change the current state based on a StateTransitionRequest, returning success or failure and an error reason.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new State object based on the application context and target lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if transitioning from a start state to a target state is valid, given the current transition path.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application context to a new lifecycle state, recording errors if any.
